sdk_identity.implicit_transport: One InitConnect handshake, optional KeepAlive only. Initial subscription registry empty; automatic reconnect disabled before first connection attempt. No account or subscription queries.
sdk_identity.docs: Official pages direct-open timed out in this turn; previously read official documentation plus official cached search excerpts support API semantics. Installed SDK source hashes bind actual signature/behavior.

session_selection: Last XNYS session closed at least120seconds before execution; compute once before context, retain exact calendar.
protocol_guard: SDK processor boundary rejects second page before delegate/send; retains first successful decoded history page even if public API discards it.
snapshot_clock: Require both symbol update_time parsed NY and not future; no live-fill freshness qualification.
native_readback: Valid exact-session bars only, raw labels retained, normalized end +1minute, isolated Qlib OHLCV store/readback; no fake store on invalid source.
